name: Stella Swarovski Necklace and Earrings set
short: A precious prismatic style inspired by the magic of the sky permeates this Swarovski set that includes a star motif necklace and luminous button earrings, perfect to complete a casual look. Spend your days in the brightest way possible with the Stella set!
description: The versatility of the Stella set will fascinate you from the first moment . For this season Swarovski brings a set that consists of a women's necklace with star and radiant button earrings. The 38 cm adjustable Swarovski necklace , inspired by the Austrian landscape, is rhodium-plated and features an eye-catching star embellished with clear zirconia that perfectly matches the stud earrings. This beautiful jewelry set is the perfect gift to inspire or inspire you to wear divine looks, with the typical Swarovski sparkle.
